roadmap.title: NEET-PG 2026 counselling roadmap
roadmap.source: MCC tentative schedule, notice of 7 Oct 2026. State rounds follow each MCC round; confirm with your state authority.

stages.name: Registration
stages.detail: Round 1 registration and payment (12–21 Oct, till 12 noon) and choice locking (until 22 Oct, 10 am).

stages.name: Round 1 result
stages.detail: Result on 24 Oct. Join or upload documents 26 Oct – 2 Nov: freeze (join in person) or float (upload online). Free exit in this round.

stages.name: Round 2
stages.detail: Registration 6–11 Nov, choice locking until 12 Nov, 10 am, result 14 Nov, joining 16–23 Nov. Not joining or resigning forfeits the security deposit.

stages.name: Round 3
stages.detail: Registration 26 Nov – 1 Dec, choice locking until 2 Dec, 10 am, result 4 Dec, reporting 5–12 Dec. No resignation; not joining loses the deposit and ends MCC counselling.

stages.name: Stray vacancy
stages.detail: Registration 16–21 Dec, choices close 21 Dec, 11:55 pm, result 24 Dec, reporting 24–31 Dec. Final round: a seat here must be joined.
